name: Randgold & Exploration Company Limited
source: Randgold & Exploration Company Limited notice of annual general meeting and summarised group financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (https://randgoldexp.co.za/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Randgold-Exploration-Company-Ltd-Notice-of-the-AGM-13-May-2026.pdf), summarised group statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, page 17, audited by KPMG Inc. with an unmodified opinion. Figures in rand thousands, stored in absolute rand. Revenue is nil in both years, as the statement prints. Operating Expenses FY2025 14 877 is personnel expenses 10 090 plus other operating expenses 7 084 less the 2 297 change in fair value of investments in securities, and FY2024 17 175 is 10 063 plus 9 465 less 2 353, because the fixed label set has no row for the fair value movement; that makes Operating Profit (EBIT) equal the statement's loss from operating activities, and EBIT plus finance income 3 713 (2024: 5 091) equals the loss before taxation exactly. Taxation is nil. EPS is the basic and diluted loss per share printed in cents, converted to rand per share: 15.60 cents for 2025 and 16.88 cents for 2024. The earlier FY2025 and FY2024 operating figures of 17 174 000 and 19 528 000 were the gross expense lines and are replaced. Read 2026-11-11.
